label: A represented complete history recovers the switch schedule but leaves root attributes open
paraphrase: For admitted #468 routes paired with #1867 Boolean copy/toggle schedules, the complete generated trace identifies the switch schedule. Two admitted routes with the same trace have opposite HAS_INTELLECT_1 and HAS_WILL_1 values at the designated root, so neither attribute is identified. The nonempty restriction by the existing immateriality-to-intellect and intellect-to-will premises makes both attributes true throughout. The augmented observation identifies the attribute pair exactly when, for every same-history pair with different attributes, at least one permitted report distinguishes that pair. This is a control on the supplied profile, with source-to-history applicability and any real separating report OPEN. The represented history is a function of the schedule alone (Model is an unconstrained product of route and schedule), so non-identification of the root attributes holds by construction; the substantive content is the augment criterion and the restriction result. The impersonal witness is a model where 180f5ad2 fails; it shows that premise is needed for the attribute in this profile, not that it is false.
